scope: Newest-first ME5 Iron Defender and its identical earlier ME1 printing. Artwork and true BREAK excluded.

ruleReferences.facts: M5 Item: own Metal Pokemon take30 less damage from opposing Pokemon attacks during next opponent turn, including later entrants. Metal icon are omitted by text extraction; FAQ and bilingual source explicitly identify Metal.
Original M1L Iron Defender printing, same effect as ME5 reprint.
Direct official FAQ: legal with no own Metal Pokemon; two uses stack to60 reduction.

B-05 pp19 and B-07 pp20 explicitly use Iron Defender as received-damage effect, after weakness/resistance. Sonic Edge bypasses this effect on opposing Active. This is direct example, not an assumption that player storage makes it unbypassable.

evidence.textEn: During your opponent's next turn, all of your Pokémon take 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). (This includes new Pokémon that come into play.)
evidence.textZh: 在下一个对手的回合，自己所有宝可梦，受到对手的宝可梦的招式的伤害「-30」[在计算弱点、抗性之后]。[也包括新出场的宝可梦。]
